instructions: Official Beacon character sheet for Cypher. A GM can turn any sheet into an NPC stat block from the gear menu, under Sheet type. Only viewers with GM rights see an NPC's stat block, but the sheet only hides it from view. Journal permissions are what actually keep players out, so do not give players access to an NPC's journal entry. Token bars can be pointed at most of the sheet from a token's settings: the three Pools, NPC health, each of the three wound tiers, a shield's three tiers, the Luck Pool, Stress, the damage track, recovery rolls remaining, cyphers carried against the limit, XP, Story XP, resource points, tier, Effort and superhero rank. Wounds, the shield, Luck, Stress, the damage track and the three counters accept edits from the bar; tier, Effort, rank, recovery rolls and cyphers carried are read-only. A wound bar fills as damage is taken, the opposite of a Pool. A value the character does not have reads blank rather than 0. Whatever a bar is linked to shows its numbers on the map to anyone allowed to see that bar, so keep an NPC's bars hidden from players if the numbers should stay secret. GM rights are checked when the sheet opens, so a player promoted to GM must close and reopen the sheet.
